task: Independent advisory review of the Context Packer implementation (packer.py) and the John Carmack architecture review BEFORE the refactor begins. Provide additional insights, disagreements, and recommendations beyond Carmack's report.
context: Background: Context Packer v2 (.opencode/skills/context-packer/packer.py, 1157 lines, 34 methods) has a confirmed bundle-explosion bug: _trim_to_token_limit removes ALL priority-1 themes in insertion order when total tokens exceed MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS=150000, because no theme name matches the CRITICAL_START/END keyword sets — so every theme is priority 1. Trace confirmed: 221 files/~899K tokens split into 12 bundles where 11 are strategy_part24-34 and general=config; all core engine themes (mandates, oracle_core, memory, observability, mcp_hub) are DISCARDED. John Carmack reviewed (task ses_01e504380ffeYo9NJaPR1deFd9) and recommended: kill the split/trim/consolidate/reorder pipeline; make packer-config.yaml the single source of truth with explicit curated file lists + explicit per-theme priorities; add a curate_packs.py tool; simplify to 4 phases (resolve → count → order → write). Carmack report: docs/research/R_CONTEXT_PACKER_ARCH_REVIEW_20260808.md. Deliverables: two Web Claude packs (sovereign-audit, tech-architecture-research) ≤12 bundles each. Mandates M1 (AnyIO), M7 (local-first), M13 (temple-grade), M18 (token efficiency), M21 (contract tests), M23 (no soft-failure).
result: Independent advisory review completed by cline/omega-engine.
